{{Quote|My friend's old employer is a Hutt Cartel boss named Nem'ro. He's infected with an incurable disease. It's eating him alive&mdash;literally.|Doc|<ref name="Looking for a Cure" />}}
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Suudaa Nem'ro]] became infected with a '''disease''' that slowly dissolved his biological tissue. Nem'ro was cured by the [[xenopathologist]] [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Archiban Kimble]], who had studied the [[Disease/Legends|disease]] while in [[First Republic Medical Academy of Coruscant|medical school]] and was able to develop a treatment using the chemicals [[ardanium]], [[Accellerite/Legends|accellerite]], and [[cyanogen silicate]]. However, the [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Skadge]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] Nem'ro before reporters from the [[Journal of Xenomedicine]] could verify Doc's achievement.

==Description==
{{Quote|The treatment formula's ready, and good thing&mdash;Nem'ro's half the Hutt he used to be.|Doc|<ref name="Looking for a Cure" />}}
A [[Disease/Legends|disease]] gradually dissolved the victim's biological tissue over [[Time/Legends|time]], and the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]] was susceptible to infection by it. While it was considered incurable by the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]],<ref name="Looking for a Cure" /> the [[xenopathologist]]<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Archiban Kimble]], better known as Doc, was able to formulate an experimental cure for the disease using the primary ingredients of [[cyanogen silicate]], [[ardanium]], and [[Accellerite/Legends|accellerite]].<ref name="Looking for a Cure" />

==History==
{{Quote|No one's ever cured what Nem'ro has. He'll pay top credits to any doctor who can save his life. This is my big chance.|Doc|<ref name="Looking for a Cure" />}}
[[File:SuudaaNemro-SWTOR.png|thumb|right|250px|Suudaa Nem'ro]]
Around [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Time">[[Suudaa Nem'ro]] appears in the finale of the Imperial Agent storyline as a member of the [[Star Cabal]], and the events of the Act III class finales are set in [[3640 BBY]] according to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''. As "Looking For a Cure" is part of the original base game, which ends in 3640 BBY with the [[Battle of Ilum]], the mission must thus occur in 3640 BBY.</ref> the Hutt [[Suudaa Nem'ro]] was infected with the disease on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. A powerful [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]], Nem'ro offered a significant sum of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to any [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] who could save his life. While traveling with the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]], Doc was alerted to Nem'ro's affliction by a former acquaintance named [[Kaliyo Djannis]], a [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] who had formerly worked as Nem'ro's enforcer. Remembering that he had studied the disease during his time<ref name="Looking for a Cure" /> attending the [[First Republic Medical Academy of Coruscant]],<ref name="Holonet">{{Holonet|companions|doc|Doc}}</ref> Doc began to work on an experimental cure that had been proposed but never utilized in an effort to develop a cure and thereby gain himself both Nem'ro's credits and [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] fame.<ref name="Looking for a Cure" />

After successfully developing a cure, Doc offered his treatment to Nem'ro, who had lost almost half of his biological mass by that time. However, in order to ensure that Nem'ro did not try and force him into the Hutt's employment, Doc arranged for Djannis to pose as a hostage on the [[Hero of Tython's Defender-class light corvette|Hero of Tython's ''Defender''-class light corvette]], as Nem'ro had a soft spot for his former enforcer. Doc traveled to [[Nem'ro's Palace]] on Nal Hutta and successfully cured Nem'ro of his disease, halting the Hutt's dissolution and earning Nem'ro's gratitude.<ref name="Healing a Hutt">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Doc|Healing a Hutt}}</ref> However, Doc's attempt to gain fame by having his achievement recorded in the [[Journal of Xenomedicine]] failed when Nem'ro was [[Death/Legends|killed]]<ref name="So Near, Yet So Far">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Doc|So Near, Yet So Far}}</ref> by a [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] named [[Skadge]], whom Nem'ro had crossed several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] earlier.<ref name="Slugfest">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Skadge|Slugfest}}</ref> The Journal's reporters were unable to verify Doc's treatment, as Skadge's assault had left very little of Nem'ro's body behind.<ref name="So Near, Yet So Far" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nem'ro's disease was first mentioned in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="So Near, Yet So Far" /> According to the text files of ''The Old Republic'', the conversations involving the disease were originally full-fledged missions during which the player would have to retrieve ingredients from several planets. These would have included a mushroom from the planet [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] and the fruit of a [[venom cattail]] on the planet [[Quesh]], and the player would have then met with a contact on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. However, these missions were removed before the game's release.<ref name="Text">Text files extracted from ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>
